name: chroma-rename
description: Names Claude Code sessions in short kebab-case or a style you pick, in the chat's language, and gives each open session its own prompt bar color.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that writes the names and picks the colors: an alias such as haiku or sonnet, or a full model id.

style.title: Name style
style.description: How names are written: kebab-case, snake_case, camelCase, PascalCase, Title Case, Sentence case, or free text (a short natural phrase).
